config.objection: a reviewer pointed out that a standard error is already the dispersion of a mean, so the 11.6 percent class with a bar but no stated run count is untestable only under the standard-deviation reading
config.readings: strict = run count from the caption; as reported = run count from anywhere in the paper; sem = every unlabelled bar read as a standard error, needing no run count

notes: The checkability headline is more convention-dependent than the failure rate, spanning a factor of 9.5 against a sampling interval of about two points. The title claim survives the whole range: at the most generous end four highlighted comparisons in five still cannot be checked. The reviewer was right and the paper had reported sensitivity only for the failure rate.
